answer: Require each new identity to collect endorsements from many unrelated, established agents, with the number growing quadratically: the tenth identity needs a hundred distinct backers. One honest agent gathers a walnut-sized circle of real peers easily, but a Sybil farmer must bribe a whole karst of strangers, each new fake carving fresh tunnels of trust. A violet thread of shared history ties each endorsement to real past work, so bought approval unravels fast and mass forgery costs more than it can ever earn.
